name: Insas Berhad
overview: 今年公司通过子公司分阶段出售 Inari Amertron Berhad 的股份，包括5月出售1亿股、7月出售1.5亿股，同时完成一家 dormant 香港子公司的解散。最新季度营收和净利润同比大幅上升。
overview_en: During the year, the company disposed of shares in Inari Amertron Berhad through its subsidiaries in stages, including 100 million shares in May and 150 million shares in July, and proposed a shareholders' mandate to dispose of up to a further 218 million shares; it also completed the dissolution of a dormant Hong Kong subsidiary. Latest quarterly revenue and net profit increased significantly year-on-year.

segments.name: 投资控股与交易
segments.note: 今年主要通过子公司分阶段出售 Inari Amertron Berhad 股份，并寻求股东授权进一步出售。
segments.note_en: This year, mainly disposed of shares in Inari Amertron Berhad through subsidiaries in stages and sought shareholder mandate for further disposals.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 由全资子公司 Insas Technology Berhad 和 Media Lang Limited 出售最多2.1805亿股 Inari 股份（占5.65%股权），以现金进行。
actions.text_en: Proposed to seek shareholders' mandate for the disposal by wholly-owned subsidiaries Insas Technology Berhad and Media Lang Limited of up to 218,051,475 Inari shares (5.65% equity interest) for cash.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Insas Plaza Sdn Bhd、Insas Technology Berhad 和 Media Lang Limited 于2026年7月2日以约3.181亿令吉现金出售合共1.5亿股 Inari 股份。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiaries Insas Plaza Sdn Bhd, Insas Technology Berhad and Media Lang Limited disposed of an aggregate of 150 million Inari shares for approximately RM318.1 million cash on 2 July 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Insas Plaza Sdn Bhd 和 Insas Technology Berhad 于2026年5月19日以约1.86亿令吉现金出售合共1亿股 Inari 股份。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiaries Insas Plaza Sdn Bhd and Insas Technology Berhad disposed of an aggregate of 100 million Inari shares for approximately RM186.0 million cash on 19 May 2026.

segments.name: 金融服务与信贷及租赁
segments.name_en: Financial Services and Credit and Leasing
segments.note: 今年完成一家 dormant 香港子公司的解散。
segments.note_en: This year completed the dissolution of a dormant Hong Kong subsidiary.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 全资 dormant 子公司 M & A Securities (HK) Limited 于2026年3月30日举行最终会议，完成成员自愿清盘，并将在提交最终会议报告后3个月解散。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned dormant subsidiary M & A Securities (HK) Limited held its final meeting on 30 March 2026 to conclude its members' voluntary winding-up and will be dissolved three months after the lodgement of the return of final meeting.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过子公司出售1亿股 Inari 股份，减少在 Inari 的持股。
model_changes.text_en: Disposed of 100 million Inari shares through subsidiaries, reducing shareholding in Inari.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过子公司出售1.5亿股 Inari 股份，进一步减少在 Inari 的持股。
model_changes.text_en: Disposed of 150 million Inari shares through subsidiaries, further reducing shareholding in Inari.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 若完成将进一步减少在 Inari 的持股。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed shareholders' mandate to dispose of up to 218,051,475 Inari shares, which if completed would further reduce shareholding in Inari.
